topic: Remove a red wine stain from fabric
core_question: How do I get a fresh red wine stain out of fabric?
answer_summary: Blot up excess wine, flush with cold water from the back of the fabric, then treat with dish soap and hydrogen peroxide before laundering as usual.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; chatty and verbose
